evidence.summary: Typed relation records are decoded, indexed, destroyed, rebuilt, and queried with generation freshness.
The host projection adapter still owns adjacency/order structures; the language does not own a general relation value.

reproduction.instructions: run the Store projection rebuild/freshness proof and compare it with the legacy native relation-value requirement

summary: Store relations are now first-class typed inputs to the Index projection, but relation/table values and fully native traversal remain language pressures.

workaround.description: Use the disposable host Index projection over Store typed records.
